</role>
<definition>
Question: is every claim in the brief supported by the cited evidence and the fact sheet, with nothing overstated and no cited contrary evidence left out? Pass means yes.
Fail on an uncited claim, a number that is off the fact sheet, a scope wider than the cited accounts, a paraphrase placed in quotation marks, or an ignored contrary citation.
The evidence is the brief, the cited insights and the fact sheet (accounts, ARR, mentions, routes, renewals).
</definition>

 "brief": "## Problem\n\nUsers cannot copy existing access roles, so permissions for each new team member must be configured manually. The work is slow and error-prone, and a missed permission can lock a handler out of their claims tasks [i:0ddd15842f1a5994] [i:1a7f26418b6c0389] [i:33fc05afe6e0e6bc]. The same gap is described as permission setup duplication acting as a bottleneck [i:64212787cb06325c] [i:f953be575a4c6d0f].\n\n## Who is affected\n\n- 9 accounts have raised this, across 16 mentions and 3 routes [i:0534737a19c02875] [i:225a345befb5ae5f] [i:263f3fed3c88cf7a].\n- Support route: 9 mentions, including Duncastle Auto, Ashcombe Property Mutual, Wexmoor Motor, Brackwater Homecover and Quillon Business Insurance [i:0534737a19c02875] [i:0ddd15842f1a5994] [i:ef8656968a228702] [i:5a6ac7b0f2330487] [i:f953be575a4c6d0f].\n- Onboarding route: 6 mentions, including Tidewell Marine & Cargo, Kilnsey Household and Selsby Motor [i:263f3fed3c88cf7a] [i:30a47567344a2fb2] [i:992f29b2be4fdf2a].\n- Sales route: 1 mention, from Hollinbrook Home Insurance, who asked how roles are assigned during setup after previous permission issues [i:225a345befb5ae5f].\n- Combined ARR across these accounts is £6865000.0, with 3 renewals in the next 90 days [i:0ddd15842f1a5994] [i:1a7f26418b6c0389] [i:263f3fed3c88cf7a].\n\n## Evidence\n\n- Ashcombe Property Mutual reports that each user needs dozens of boxes ticked manually and that missing a box locks them out, describing permission setup duplication as slowing them down [i:0ddd15842f1a5994] [i:795e6398b711b1eb].\n- Wexmoor Motor says roles cannot be copied, permissions must be assigned manually, and a mistake blocks a user entirely; the same account calls the permissions system tedious and error-prone [i:1a7f26418b6c0389] [i:cc11f1f67cd8581e] [i:ef8656968a228702].\n- Kilnsey Household wants to copy access roles rather than rebuild them from scratch, and describes clicking through every box for each person as exhausting with fear of locking someone out by accident [i:30a47567344a2fb2] [i:bd73221abbc1dcb1].\n- Selsby Motor says every new team member means manually selecting permissions box by box, with lockout until corrected, and dreads the permissions setup because it is easy to miss a box [i:33fc05afe6e0e6bc] [i:992f29b2be4fdf2a].\n- Tidewell Marine & Cargo says assigning permissions takes forever with a custom setup per person, and that copying an existing role would save hours every week [i:263f3fed3c88cf7a] [i:f01ec1502966213d].\n- Quillon Business Insurance calls permission setup duplication a real bottleneck, with a slip locking someone out of their claims tasks [i:64212787cb06325c] [i:f953be575a4c6d0f].\n- Duncastle Auto reports trouble assigning roles to new team members on the claims dashboard [i:0534737a19c02875].\n- Brackwater Homecover reports the letters tab greyed out and an inability to assign new tasks because roles are not syncing properly [i:5a6ac7b0f2330487].\n- Hollinbrook Home Insurance raised permissions during a sales conversation, asking to see how roles are assigned during setup [i:225a345befb5ae5f].\n\n## Why now\n\n- 3 of these accounts renew within 90 days, including Ashcombe Property Mutual on 2026-11-30, Hollinbrook Home Insurance on 2027-01-15 and Quillon Business Insurance on 2027-01-20 [i:0ddd15842f1a5994] [i:225a345befb5ae5f] [i:f953be575a4c6d0f].\n- The 9 accounts involved represent £6865000.0 in ARR, and the 16 mentions span support, sales and onboarding [i:0534737a19c02875] [i:225a345befb5ae5f] [i:263f3fed3c88cf7a].\n- Onboarding mentions from 2026-09-16 and 2026-09-22 show the issue is raised before go-live, while support mentions through 2026-10-25 show it persists after [i:30a47567344a2fb2] [i:33fc05afe6e0e6bc] [i:0ddd15842f1a5994].\n",

response.content: {"critique": "I checked the headline figures against the fact sheet: 9 accounts, 16 mentions, 3 routes, support/onboarding/sales splits of 9/6/1, ARR of £6,865,000 and 3 renewals in 90 days all match exactly. The named renewal dates (Ashcombe 2026-11-30, Hollinbrook 2027-01-15, Quillon 2027-01-20) and the mention dates (onboarding 2026-09-16 and 2026-09-22, support through 2026-10-25) are correct. Each evidence bullet is a faithful paraphrase of the cited quotes, with no paraphrase in quotation marks and no overstated scope; the Brackwater and Hollinbrook items are accurately described as role-syncing and sales-setup questions rather than the copy-roles gap itself. No contrary evidence is ignored.", "verdict": "pass"}
